description: Planning node that selects simulation case and parameters based on user prompt
philosophy: Intent-driven contract defining REQUIRED outputs to fix known bugs

required_inputs.note_on_state_pollution: architect_node reads from top-level inputs (prompt, config) ONLY. No downstream node should read computation output from top-level state.

required_outputs.description: Dual validation paths: canonical (workflow_history source of truth) + pragmatic (state convenience copies)

utility_flags_top_level_REQUIRED.mode: Literal['proceed', 'fail'] (control flow indicator, next node or terminal)

canonical_data_location_PRIMARY.purpose: Source of truth for audit trail, reproducibility, debugging

pragmatic_data_location_OPTIONAL.note: Fallback path for debugging if state is corrupted or polluted

state_updates_returned.description: Dict returned by architect_node updates state with only these fields
state_updates_returned.workflow_history: List[Dict] (append new entry with planning results)

baseline_structure_CRITICAL.description: FIX #1: Architect must compute and return baseline metadata. Runner cannot find executable without it.

optional_outputs.plan: Dict (combined plan object for backwards compatibility with input_writer)

workflow_history_entry_CANONICAL.description: FIX #7: All nodes must use canonical workflow_history format. Computation output stored ONLY here, not in top-level state

required_fields.details: Dict[str, Any] (CONTAINS all computation output for this planning step)

details_execution_metadata.indexing_calls_count: int (number of embedding invocations performed during planning, can be 0)
details_execution_metadata.indexing_calls_total: int (cumulative embedding invocations across workflow, can be 0)
details_execution_metadata.indexing_calls_detail: Dict[str,int] (per-call-type delta for this planning step)

details.reasoning: Selected Advection_AmrCore case because user requested an AMReX test problem

simple_indexing.description: Development approach: single FAISS search, proven to work e2e

hierarchical_indexing.description: Experimental approach: L0/L1/L2 hierarchical search, under comparative testing
validation_rules: workflow_history[-1]['details'] must contain 'case_candidates' or reference to candidates

input.prompt: Run 2D premixed flame simulation with PMF case

test_cases.description: Hierarchical indexing: 2D flame simulation request with L0/L1/L2

input.prompt: Run 2D premixed flame simulation with PMF case

test_cases.description: Hierarchical fails gracefully and falls back to simple

input.prompt: Invalid/ambiguous prompt that might fail hierarchical

critical_bug_fixes.title: Missing baseline metadata (runner cannot find executable)
critical_bug_fixes.requirement: architect_node MUST return baseline dict with code_name, repo_path, case_path, local_path

critical_bug_fixes.title: Plan dict format mismatch (confusing API between services)
critical_bug_fixes.requirement: execute_planning() normalizes both create_plan() and create_plan_rag() outputs to canonical format
critical_bug_fixes.validation_in_contract: required_outputs section (selected_case, modifications at top level)

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: Must contain ALL computation output: selected_case, modifications (full list), reasoning (full), baseline, indexing_strategy, indexing_calls_count
schema_compliance_checklist.violation_consequence: Audit trail incomplete, reproducibility broken, debugging impossible

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: CAN have convenience copies of: selected_case, modifications, reasoning, baseline, plan. Must match workflow_history.details if present.
schema_compliance_checklist.canonical_format: Same structure as workflow_history.details, OR OMITTED entirely
schema_compliance_checklist.violation_consequence: Confusion, but audit trail (canonical path) remains valid. Downstream nodes must prefer workflow_history.

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: Must be immutable append-only list with canonical entry format (node, timestamp, action, iteration, details)
schema_compliance_checklist.violation_consequence: Audit trail breaks, cannot replay workflow

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: MUST be computed by architect and stored in workflow_history[-1]['details']['baseline']
schema_compliance_checklist.canonical_format: See baseline_structure_CRITICAL with code_name, repo_path, case_path, local_path

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: MUST include indexing_strategy and indexing_calls_count for comparative testing; include indexing_calls_total when available
schema_compliance_checklist.violation_consequence: Cannot compare strategies or debug indexing performance
